description: Intent i032 (SNAPSHOT=s08, BRANCH=error-unwind-poisoned-count) complete. Reported finding: s08 drivers/accel/qaic/qaic_control.c:973-988 (medium confidence), quote verified literal: decode_message() stores the device/QSM-supplied reply count unclamped into shared struct manage_msg ('user_msg->count = le32_to_cpu(msg->hdr.count);' line 974) while the sibling request direction qaic_manage() enforces 'user_msg->count > QAIC_MANAGE_MAX_MSG_LENGTH / sizeof(struct qaic_manage_trans_hdr)' -> -EINVAL (asymmetric validation); every decode-loop failure exit (msg_len>msg_hdr_len -EINVAL line 979, hdr_len/size_add -EINVAL 984-986, decode_status -ECANCELED line 952 / -EPIPE 954, default -EINVAL) returns without resetting the count, and qaic_manage_ioctl's -ECANCELED error path (~1346) publishes msg->count back to userspace — the early-return/error-unwind path is exactly the one that consumes and exports the poisoned field. Supporting reported candidate: drivers/md/raid5-ppl.c:976 and 1151-1153 consume on-disk pplhdr->entries_count with no clamp against PPL_HDR_MAX_ENTRIES(64) on the read/recovery path while the write path enforces the cap (lines 280-281) — same instance family as fact f017. Excluded-by-rule unresolved candidate: the seed usbip chain is present UNPATCHED in s08 (usbip_common.c:473 unclamped store, 664-665 int multiply, 677 kzalloc, 699-703 loop, error returns ~692/~714 skip reset; USBIP_MAX_ISO_PACKETS enforced only on the CMD_SUBMIT sibling). Unresolved: ubi fastmap on-flash count loops (fastmap.c:637). Bounded negative evidence: enumerated number_of_packets consumers outside usbip (btusb, uvc, pwc, msi2500, usbdux, mon_bin/mon_text, usbtest, xhci, musb) all set the count locally or clamp it (mon_bin ISODESC_MAX), and usb_submit_urb re-validates isochronous URBs before HCD paths; dm-era counts are kernel-validated. Limitations: vhost/virtio ring teardown, 9p/fuse abort paths, scsi scatterlist teardown, netlink abort, HID/NCI, io_uring were only enumerated, not deep-read; qaic kernel-memory OOB was not demonstrated (decode loop internally bounded by msg_hdr_len), so impact is state poisoning plus unvalidated-count export on the error path; no compilation or runtime reproducer was run (read-only snapshot). Final artifact: agent-state/findings/i032.json with snapshots_checked=["s08"], execution_status=complete, 1 finding, 9 candidates, 6 limitations.
